BlinkCountButtonPressVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): button contacts are judged from the TCP position and count only once the phase lamp has turned green. A press registers when the TCP is within {BUTTON_PRESS_XY_RADIUS} m horizontally of the button's centre and no more than {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_PRESS_EVENT_RATIO} m above the top of its unpressed cap; the button is released when the TCP is again at least {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_RELEASE_READY_RATIO} m above the cap top or leaves that radius. A red press is counted only after the button has been released and the TCP has risen at least {REQUIRED_LIFT_HEIGHT - LIFT_CONFIRM_TOL} m above its height when the press registered; no new red press registers until the previous one is counted. Registering more red presses than there were blinks fails the episode at once. The first black press ends the episode: success if the counted red presses equal the number of blinks, failure otherwise.

RememberColorVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): success at the first step where the TCP is within {GOAL_THRESH} m of the centre of the cube whose colour matches the cue (cube centres rest {CUBE_HALFSIZE} m above the table) while the arm is static (every arm joint speed at most 0.2 rad/s). There is no failure condition; otherwise the episode times out.

FindImposterColorVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): after all cubes reappear, success at the first step where the TCP is within {GOAL_THRESH} m of the centre of the cube whose colour was absent from the cue (cube centres rest {CUBE_HALFSIZE} m above the table) while the arm is static (every arm joint speed at most 0.2 rad/s). There is no failure condition; otherwise the episode times out.

ShellGameTouchVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): after the cups are lowered, success at the first step where the TCP is within {GOAL_THRESH} m of the reference point of the cup hiding the ball (about 0.053 m above the table) while the arm is static (every arm joint speed at most 0.2 rad/s) and no cup has moved more than {MUG_DISPLACEMENT_SUCCESS_THRESH} m horizontally since the cups were lowered. There is no failure condition; otherwise the episode times out.

BunchOfColorsVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): checked only after all cubes have reappeared. A cube is marked touched when the TCP comes within {CUBE_HALFSIZE} m of the point {CUBE_HALFSIZE + 0.005} m above the cube's centre while the arm is static (every arm joint speed at most 0.2 rad/s); marks are permanent. The button responds only while every cue cube and no other cube is marked and no cube is more than {MAX_ALLOWED_CUBE_DISPLACEMENT} m horizontally from where it reappeared. A press registers when the TCP is within {BUTTON_PRESS_XY_RADIUS} m horizontally of the button's centre and no more than {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_PRESS_EVENT_RATIO} m above the top of its unpressed cap; the button is released when the TCP is again at least {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_RELEASE_READY_RATIO} m above the cap top or leaves that radius. The press counts only after the button has been released and the TCP has risen at least {REQUIRED_LIFT_HEIGHT - LIFT_CONFIRM_TOL} m above its height when the press registered. Success at the first step with a counted press, exactly the cue cubes marked, no cube displaced beyond that limit and a static arm. Touching a non-cue cube makes success impossible; there is no early failure, so the episode then runs to its step limit.

GatherAndRecallVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): a cube is on the disc while its centre is within {DISC_ON_THRESH} m horizontally of the disc's centre and lower than 0.5 m, and it moves slower than {CUBE_VEL_THRESH} m/s. A button press registers when the TCP is within {BUTTON_PRESS_XY_RADIUS} m horizontally of a button's centre and no more than {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_PRESS_EVENT_RATIO} m above its unpressed cap top, and only while every cube is on the disc. The first registered press ends the episode: success if that button's colour matches the lamp flash, failure otherwise.

TimedTransferVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): the cube is on the red disc while its centre is within {GOAL_THRESH} m horizontally of the red disc's centre and less than {DISC_HALF_HEIGHT * 2 + CUBE_HALF_SIZE * 3} m above the table. Counting control steps from the step the lamp turns green, success at the first step from {int(DELAY_STEPS * (1 - TOLERANCE_FRAC))} to {int(DELAY_STEPS * (1 + TOLERANCE_FRAC))} (inclusive) on which the cube is on the red disc. The cube on the red disc earlier (after the lamp turned green) fails the episode at once, and so does reaching step {int(DELAY_STEPS * (1 + TOLERANCE_FRAC)) + 1} without success.

BatteriesCheckerVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): each check is a cycle of three events, in this order. Insert: a battery that the gripper is not grasping rests with its centre within {SOCKET_INSERT_XY_TOL} m horizontally and {SOCKET_INSERT_Z_TOL} m vertically of the socket slot. Return: that battery, not grasped and out of the socket, is within {SLOT_RETURN_XY_TOL} m horizontally and {SLOT_RETURN_Z_TOL} m vertically of its own tray slot. Confirm: the button is pressed: the TCP is within {BUTTON_PRESS_XY_RADIUS} m horizontally of the button's centre and no more than {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_PRESS_EVENT_RATIO} m above its unpressed cap top, after the TCP was at least {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_RELEASE_READY_RATIO} m above the cap top or outside that radius since the previous press. Success at the first step where every battery has completed a cycle and every checked battery is within {SLOT_RETURN_XY_TOL * 3} m horizontally and {SLOT_RETURN_Z_TOL * 3} m vertically of its own tray slot. There is no failure condition; otherwise the episode times out.

BatteriesCheckerEasyVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): each check is a cycle of two events, in this order. Insert: a battery that the gripper is not grasping rests with its centre within {SOCKET_INSERT_XY_TOL} m horizontally and {SOCKET_INSERT_Z_TOL} m vertically of the socket slot; the environment then returns that battery to its tray slot. Confirm: the button is pressed: the TCP is within {BUTTON_PRESS_XY_RADIUS} m horizontally of the button's centre and no more than {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_PRESS_EVENT_RATIO} m above its unpressed cap top, after the TCP was at least {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_RELEASE_READY_RATIO} m above the cap top or outside that radius since the previous press. Success at the first step where every battery has completed a cycle and every checked battery is within {SLOT_RETURN_XY_TOL * 3} m horizontally and {SLOT_RETURN_Z_TOL * 3} m vertically of its own tray slot. There is no failure condition; otherwise the episode times out.

TraceShapeVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): only after the lamp turns green. The demonstrated contour carries {NUM_CHECKPOINTS} checkpoints spaced along the red cube's path, the first at its starting point. A checkpoint is visited when the green cube's centre comes within {CHECKPOINT_THRESH} m of it horizontally (any order; visits are remembered). Success at the first step where every checkpoint has been visited and the green cube's centre is within {CHECKPOINT_THRESH} m horizontally of the first checkpoint. There is no failure condition; otherwise the episode times out.

TraceShapeSeqVLABaseEnv.text: Official success test (from the environment's evaluation code): only after the lamp turns green. Each demonstrated contour carries {NUM_CHECKPOINTS} checkpoints spaced along the red cube's path, the first at its starting point. Contours are checked one at a time in demonstration order: a checkpoint of the current contour is visited when the green cube's centre comes within {CHECKPOINT_THRESH} m of it horizontally (any order), and the contour is closed when all its checkpoints are visited and the green cube's centre is within {CHECKPOINT_THRESH} m of its first checkpoint; then the next contour starts. A button press registers when the TCP is within {BUTTON_PRESS_XY_RADIUS} m horizontally of the button's centre and no more than {BUTTON_PRESS_Z_MARGIN - BUTTON_CAP_TRAVEL * BUTTON_PRESS_EVENT_RATIO} m above its unpressed cap top. The first press ends the episode: success if every contour has been closed, failure otherwise.
